hetzner401.help:
The Hetzner Cloud API refused the request:
• 401 unauthorized — the token is wrong, or it was revoked or rotated: use a current one.
• 403 forbidden — the token lacks Read & Write (it is Read-only), or the project forbids the call, for example at one of its limits.
• 429 rate limit — too many requests: wait, then try again.
• 5xx — an outage at the provider; check https://status.hetzner.com/.
hetzner401.message: hetzner-cloud GET /v1/locations failed (status 401): unauthorized: unable to authenticate

hetzner403.message: hetzner-cloud GET /v1/locations failed (status 403): forbidden: insufficient permissions

storeLocked.help: This target store's secrets are encrypted, and AppRafter holds no key for them: AppRafter locked, or the store was locked from a terminal while AppRafter was open. Unlock AppRafter with the lock password or the recovery key, then try again.
storeLocked.message: the target store at /home/a/stores/work is locked, and AppRafter holds no key for it

storeNotPrivate.help: Whoever can replace a file there can swap in a token, a kubeconfig or a vault of their own and send your next deploy to a project or a cluster of their choosing. Move the target store to a folder only you can write, or fix that folder's owner and permissions; Doctor lists every folder and file concerned.
storeNotPrivate.message: other accounts can write to /home/a/stores/work/targets, so they could replace the target store's files there: AppRafter neither uses nor writes this store's secrets until that is fixed

tokenRejected.help: The provider did not accept this token (401 unauthorized): it was mistyped, or it was revoked or rotated, or its project was deleted. A token is shown only once, when it is created: paste it again from where you saved it, or create a new one with Read & Write permission in the Hetzner Console (open the project, then Security → API tokens).

toolNotFound.help:
Install kubectl.

Nothing was sent anywhere and no credential was used: this check runs before any work starts, so trying again after installing is safe.
toolNotFound.message: `kubectl` is required by `doctor` (talks to the cluster) but is not on PATH

vaultUnreadable.help: Its contents fail their integrity check. Restore /home/a/stores/work/vault from a backup; never delete it: nothing else holds these secrets.
vaultUnreadable.message: the vault /home/a/stores/work/vault is damaged: the payload failed its authentication
